description: This is an abstract class for console commands in the Goteo PHP project. It provides base functionalities such as setting input/output interfaces, managing loggers, and logging messages with styled output, as well as dispatching events.

classes.name: AbstractCommand
classes.description: An abstract base class for creating console commands, providing common functionalities such as logging, input/output handling, and event dispatching.

methods.name: setInput
methods.description: Sets the InputInterface instance for the command.

methods.name: setOutput
methods.description: Sets the OutputInterface instance for the command.

methods.name: addLogger
methods.description: Adds a Logger instance to the command's internal log registry.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Retrieves a logger instance by name.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message with optional context, styles output if output is available.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches an event with a given name, optionally with an event object.
